header.name: Introduction to Mathematical Biology
header.description: The aim of this course is to introduce mathematics as applied in quantitative study of biological systems and biological data analysis. Use of ordinary and partial differential equations (ODEs) will be emphasized in this course. Both exact and numerical solutions will be discussed. We also plan to briefly introduce dynamical systems analysis for ODEs.
prerequisites_mandatory: Summer Refresher Course (for CB PG students)

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to apply mathematical tools for quantitative analysis of biological systems

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students will gain working knowledge of dynamical systems theory tools to analyze biological models based on differential equations

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to analyze simple biochemical kinetics using ODEs and non-dimensionalize ODEs

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to construct dynamical models based on signalling, metabolic, and gene regulatory networks and analyze it

outcomes.label: CO5
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to apply the concepts of mathematical biology in some problems of systems biology and Monte Carlo simulations

weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Introduction to Matlab, Graphing of functions, and basics of calculus.

lecture_topics: Qualitative behavior of linear and nonlinear ODEs
Construction of rate-balance and direction field plots
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Writing simple matlab codes for ODEs using anonymous function

lecture_topics: Developing an epidemiology model and analyzing it
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Write Matlab code to analyze the epidemiological model

lecture_topics: Linear and nonlinear second-order differential equations
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Paper and Pencil problem solving of eigenvalue-eigenvector equations
paper and pen problem solving and Matlab simulations

lecture_topics: Derivation of Mass action and Michaelis-Menten equations and building ODE models

weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Matlab simulations of neuronal dynamics. Action Potential simulations
Paper and pen problem solving and Matlab simulations
XPPAUT simulations of bistability and oscillations

lecture_topics: Basics of Probability in cell biology
Stochastic simulations of gene signalling networks

2. Computational Cell Biology edited by C.P. Fall, E.S. Marland, J.M. Wagner and J.J. Tyson. Pub: Springer (2002)
3. Advanced Engineering Mathematics by Erwin Kreyszig. Pub: Wiley India (8th / 9th Edition).
